Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1107
Claimant:
Jeremy Quinn
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
September 1, 2023
The insured reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road and stated the other vehicle drifted into
their lane as they signaled. The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been cooperative so far.
September 15, 2023
Confirmed that the driver named on the policy was the operator at the time of loss. The driver is listed on the
declarations page and the coverage was active when the incident occurred.
September 21, 2023
Police report notes the claimant was present in the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer's account
matches the general description of the collision. Two statements from other sides are on file for reference.
October 11, 2023
Reviewed the scene photographs, which confirm the approximate point of contact on the driver's side and the position
of both vehicles after impact. No independent witnesses have come forward to describe how the lane change
occurred.
October 12, 2023
Vehicle damage is mostly consistent with the impact described by the claimant. The repair estimator noted the scrape
pattern and panel deformation align with a glancing contact at moderate speed.
November 12, 2023
Checked prior loss history for the vehicle and found no earlier damage on record. Nothing in the file suggests the
damage predates the coverage start date.
November 18, 2023
The claimant reports pain in the right shoulder following the collision and says the seabtelt tightened sharply on
impact. The reported injury appears to match the kind of force expected from this type of contact.
December 30, 2023
Medical records show the claimant was terated for the same body area within the last two years, and the prior
condition appears to be adding to the current complaints. A records request has been sent to the treating provider for
clarification.
January 10, 2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, with follow-up visits continuing beyond the usual
recovery window. The adjuster will ask the treating clinician for an updated plan of care.
February 24, 2024
Spoke with the claimant again today and the account of the lane change and the sequence of events matched what
was said in the first conversation. The same details came up in every contact so far.
March 1, 2024
Based on the documentation reviewed, the claim is moving forward with the injury and property components under
evaluation. Next steps include obtaining the complete treatment history and scheduling a review once the outstanding
records arrive.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
